title: read + listing endpoints
instruction: Add `GET /api/campaigns` returning all campaigns. Add `GET /api/orders` (authenticated with `Authorization: Token <token>`) returning the authenticated user's orders, newest first, with an optional `?status=active|canceled` query filter.

title: budget adjustment
instruction: Add `POST /api/campaigns/{campaignId}/adjust-budget` accepting `{ "deltaCents": <integer> }` that increases or decreases the campaign's `budgetCents` by the delta and returns the updated campaign. Reject with 409 if the new budget would be below the budget already spent by active orders. Budget/limit checks and summaries use the new budget.

title: audit log
instruction: Add an append-only audit log recording every order creation and every order cancellation, exposed via `GET /api/campaigns/{campaignId}/audit` returning entries `{ "type": "order_created"|"order_canceled", "orderId": string, "userId": string, "at": ISO-8601 }` in chronological order.

title: reporting + order versioning
instruction: Add `GET /api/campaigns/{campaignId}/report` returning `{ "perUser": [{ "userId": string, "activeOrderCount": int, "spentCents": int }], "totalActiveOrders": int, "totalSpentCents": int }`. Add a `version` integer to every order that starts at 1 and increments on each mutation (cancel increments it).
